verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents sharing one business number across a team. Its MCP docs reference Quo inboxes that hold message history, which implies texts to the number land in a team-accessible inbox. Nothing documents per-message reply attribution showing which teammate responded, and nothing explicitly describes a shared texting inbox UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a shared SMS inbox for team members, attribution of which teammate replied, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
